statement: CWiid sends speaker control and data reports over the Bluetooth HID control socket, reads a success/failure HID transaction handshake after each report write, and performs register configuration with synchronous memory-write response handling. The speaker setup script stops on failed report handshake or failed register write; the beep loop stops on failed send. It does not await a distinct input report 0x22 for each speaker-data block in its cwiid_send_rpt function; memory-write completion instead consumes its own response pipe. A virtual Bluetooth-facing implementation therefore needs appropriate control-transaction responses in addition to any native status and write replies.

applicability.revision: Original Wii Remote consumer protocol paths; no retail revision measured
